title: Start server voting!

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body:
This is just my personal opinion, but I dislike the whole /vote thing. I guess it's just me being fussy here, but I think it offers too much of a chance for people to just pop online to Avicus and do /vote for their daily credits, rather than playing games at all, since it'd give them enough credits that playing for an hour would give (depending on how much the reward is, obviously. On other servers, the reward for voting is always something remarkibly OP, so I'm getting my impression from there.) This equals to less active players.

It would also leave people without a sense of achievement once they reach a certain badge they'd been wanting to get. By this, I'm talking about how fast the reward for voting increase their credits. 

This is just me ranting on, so you don't have to consider anything I say. Just wanted to state my opinion. xP I hope Avicus will stay at least a little unique and not like some of those other clustered up servers out there.
